data.topic: Research how to make an agent ask the operator for a decision through its runtime's native ask-question tool instead of ending a turn with a prose A/B/C option menu. The runtimes in scope are Claude Code (AskUserQuestion), Codex (request_user_input), Pi (the @juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question extension), OpenCode (its built-in question tool) and every other cli runtime in this repo that has one: Devin, Cursor, DSH (DeepSeek Harness) and Hermes. Prove for each runtime whether a tool exists and give its exact name. Read-only: write only under the research artifact directory. Cite file:line, or a binary or doc source, for every finding.
